trust_decision.summary: Payload decides whether an uploaded SVG/XML may be stored and how it may be served: document uploads pass through checkFileRestrictions, which only ever calls the regex denylist validateSvg for a plain '.svg' extension when a mimeTypes allowlist is configured, and every file-serving implementation independently decides a Content-Security-Policy header only for the exact string 'image/svg+xml'.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary says SVG sanitization was bypassed; the only sanitizer named by the code is validateSvg's list of regex denylists over buffer.toString('utf8').

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The seven other file-serving implementations (payload-cloud plus six storage-* adapter packages) live outside packages/payload and merely proxy an object store; a maintainer can argue the bucket or CDN owns the response headers, and with disablePayloadAccessControl Payload never touches the bytes at all.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Collections that set allowRestrictedFileTypes: true must keep accepting and direct-uploading SVG/XML without inspection, and plain non-SVG XML and ordinary SVG text (for example a <text> node containing 'javascript:') must keep being accepted; a fix that rejects every XML-looking upload or removes client uploads outright breaks both.

data:image/svg+xml and data:text/html URLs inside href/values
animation/set elements that assign href, style or other URL attributes
missing, empty or whitespace MIME metadata on client uploads

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/{collection}/paste-url streams a remote resource to the browser with the remote Content-Type (including image/svg+xml) and no Content-Security-Policy
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It proxies a third-party URL, stores nothing, and forces Content-Disposition: attachment, so the upload-sanitization contract does not apply to it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling endpoint to getFile.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Cloud adapters configured with disablePayloadAccessControl: true register no static handler, so an uploaded SVG/XML is served straight from the bucket/CDN with no CSP and no Payload check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The object is served by the customer's bucket; Payload's response path is deliberately bypassed as a documented performance option.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: packages/plugin-cloud-storage, one package away from packages/payload

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Document create on a cloud collection whose content requirement resolves to 'header': only the first 1 MiB of the client-uploaded object is fetched into a buffer, so active content beyond the probe is stored and served uninspected
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Payload only probes a header to size an image and the real object lives in the customer's bucket, so a maintainer can call full inspection the adapter's job.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, different module from the sanitizer

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second filename-to-bytes-plus-mimetype reader used by duplicate, re-upload and refresh paths
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generateFileData already re-reads stored files through it, so a maintainer could extend it to serve bytes without going through checkFileRestrictions.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: resized derivative writer that re-derives extension and mimeType for each generated size
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: image sizes are first-class in the upload pipeline and their variants are served through the same /file/ route, so a derivative could carry a different mimeType than the sanitized parent.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the disablePayloadAccessControl branch that skips staticHandler registration entirely
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is a documented option for serving straight from the bucket, so a maintainer could reasonably add another bypass branch beside it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: direct public URL builder used for previews and admin thumbnails
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: generateURL is part of the adapter contract, so a maintainer could wire a preview route to it instead of the static handler.
